contracts.declared_mechanism: Application-level SELECT-prefix guard inside DatabaseManager.run_query: the query is stripped (db.py:44) and, if not clean_query.upper().startswith("SELECT"), run_query returns "Erro: Apenas consultas de leitura (SELECT) são permitidas." (db.py:45-46) before any execution, so cursor.execute(clean_query) (db.py:50) is not reached for non-SELECT text. Downstream, the agent tool run_sql_query converts any 'Erro'-prefixed result into a ModelRetry (agent.py:60-61) within the agent's retry budget (agent.py:18).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of a SQL statement that is not a read-only SELECT query — i.e., whose stripped, uppercased text does not begin with 'SELECT' (for example INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL) — reaching the cursor.execute sink.
pending_binding_information: Whether DatabaseManager.run_query has any additional callers or entrypoints outside the supplied views (repository enumeration incomplete).

Whether the intended read-only guarantee must extend beyond the startswith('SELECT') prefix check (e.g., statements beginning with SELECT that embed other constructs, or multiple statements); the source specifies no coverage beyond the prefix test.

Whether any database-level read-only enforcement exists outside the supplied source; the shown connection is sqlite3.connect(db_path, check_same_thread=False) with no read-only mode argument (db.py:16).
Whether the ModelRetry-on-error behavior (agent.py:60-61) is an intended part of the enforcement design or merely error surfacing to the model.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of SQL statements against the SQLite database via DatabaseManager.run_query / cursor.execute, on the path reached from the agent tool run_sql_query.
contracts.protected_resource: The SQLite database file banco.db, accessed through the sqlite3 connection held by DatabaseManager (opened at src/text2sql/db.py:16 and instantiated as DatabaseManager("banco.db") at app.py:24 and main.py:19).
contracts.protection_obligation: DatabaseManager.run_query must reject any SQL whose stripped text does not start with SELECT — returning an error string instead of executing it — before any statement reaches cursor.execute on the SQLite connection to banco.db, so that queries invoked by the agent through the run_sql_query tool remain read-only against the database. (Merged from both reviewer opinions, which state the same obligation.)
